newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - prompt mogas soars, rest steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - prompt mogas soars, rest steady.

text.p: Prompt gasoline barges soared some $5 a tonne higher on Friday, while other NWE products were steady and quiet, dealers said.

Eurograde gasoline barges traded at $212, $212.50 and $213.50 fob ARA. By late morning the market was assessed at around $214, $5 higher than the last deal on Thursday. With sellers hard to find, traders said the steep rise could continue.
"Gasoline is incredibly strong and moving totally independently of crude. If you want the barrels, you just have to pay," one trader said.
Swaps rose a more modest $2/$3 a tonne, with bids at $207 fob ARA for August, widening the front month backwardation to about $10 a tonne. Swaps sellers were not plentiful.
Heating oil barges were steady as IPE gas oil futures moved little. Prompt and second half August offers held at IPE August +$1 fob Rotterdam. Bids were no higher than +25 cents.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were slightly more active with deals at $93, as on Thursday.
